rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to express conciseness in how someone speaks or writes.

example.english: I speak with brevity and do not go on at length.
example.traditional: 我講嘢一向都講得簡潔，唔會長篇大論。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 je5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 gong2 dak1 gaan2 git3 m4 wui5 coeng4 pin1 daai6 leon6

rows.jyutping: N ge3 si4 gaan3 hou2 dyun2
rows.note: Use this when saying that an event or activity has brief duration rather than discussing concise wording.

example.english: This meeting's brevity meant it ended in no time.
example.traditional: 今次會議嘅時間好短，轉頭就散會喇。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 wui6 ji5 ge3 si4 gaan1 hou2 dyun2 zyun3 tau4 zau6 saan3 wui2 laa3
